## Highlights
### New
- Pins can stretch to fill the width of a row that isn't full, so an uneven number of pins no longer leaves empty space.
### Improved
- Opening a link in a background tab now shows a brief confirmation at the top of the window.
### Fixed
- Mouse Back and Forward buttons set up as swipes in Logitech Options+ switch Spaces when the pointer is over the sidebar, as other mice do. - Dragging an Appearance setting, such as the window border, material, Space icon size or the tab and address field colors, no longer slows the whole app down.
---
Development builds contain the newest changes and may be less reliable than stable releases.

## Highlights
### Fixed
- Downloads follow the Automatic Downloads choice of the site you’re on, including files it serves from another address, such as GitHub release files. A blocked download’s message no longer appears twice. - Chromium pages use your default zoom when they open and keep your chosen zoom as you navigate. - Chromium is updated to 154.0.8037.57 with upstream security and compatibility fixes.
